# 1. Config & Models
def test_config_defaults_and_enums():
    cfg = Config()
    assert cfg.sam_variant == "auto" and cfg.device == "auto"
    assert cfg.max_side_px == 2048 and cfg.kerf_mode == "app"
    assert cfg.cut_stroke == "#FF0000" and cfg.cut_stroke_width_mm == 0.1
    assert cfg.engrave_color == "#0000FF" and cfg.print_dpi == 600
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Config(kerf_mode="invalid")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Config(device="invalid")

def test_config_edge_inset_and_mapping():
    cfg = Config()
    assert cfg.edge_inset("mockup") == 0.5
    assert cfg.edge_inset("photo") == 0.8
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cfg.edge_inset("unknown")
    cfg2 = Config.from_mapping({"kerf_mode": "lightburn", "print_dpi": 300})
    assert cfg2.kerf_mode == "lightburn" and cfg2.print_dpi == 300
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Config.from_mapping({"bad_param": 1})

def test_prompt_validations():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Prompt(points=((10, 10),), labels=())
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Prompt(points=((10, 10),), labels=(2,))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Prompt(box=(50, 50, 40, 60))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        Prompt(box=(50, 50, 60, 40))
    assert Prompt().is_empty is True
    assert Prompt(box=(10, 10, 20, 20)).is_empty is False
    assert Prompt(points=((5, 5),), labels=(1,)).is_empty is False

def test_scale_info_validations_and_properties():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ScaleInfo(mm_per_px=0, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0, bbox_px=(0, 0, 10, 10))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ScaleInfo(mm_per_px=0.1, reference="height", reference_mm=-1.0, bbox_px=(0, 0, 10, 10))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        ScaleInfo(mm_per_px=0.1, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0, bbox_px=(10, 0, 5, 10))
    s = ScaleInfo(mm_per_px=0.25, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0, bbox_px=(100, 200, 500, 600))
    assert s.width_mm == pytest.approx(100.0)
    assert s.height_mm == pytest.approx(100.0)
    mat = MaterialProfile(id="acrylic-3", name="Akril 3mm", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.18)
    assert mat.min_feature_mm == 1.5

# 2. Mask Ops (deo 1)
def test_mask_ops_components_and_count():
    mask = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=bool)
    mask[10:40, 10:40] = True   # 900 px
    mask[50:70, 50:70] = True   # 400 px
    comps = mask_ops.components(mask)
    assert len(comps) == 2
    assert np.count_nonzero(comps[0]) == 900
    assert np.count_nonzero(comps[1]) == 400
    assert mask_ops.count_components(mask) == 2
    diag = np.zeros((10, 10), dtype=bool)
    diag[2, 2] = True
    diag[3, 3] = True
    assert mask_ops.count_components(diag) == 1

def test_mask_ops_largest_component():
    m = np.zeros((60, 60), dtype=bool)
    m[2:5, 2:5] = True
    m[20:50, 20:50] = True
    largest = mask_ops.largest_component(m)
    assert np.count_nonzero(largest) == 900
    assert largest[3, 3] == False and largest[25, 25] == True
    assert np.count_nonzero(mask_ops.largest_component(np.zeros((10, 10), dtype=bool))) == 0

def test_mask_ops_fill_holes():
    m = np.zeros((50, 50), dtype=bool)
    m[10:40, 10:40] = True
    m[20:30, 20:30] = False
    filled = mask_ops.fill_holes(m)
    assert filled[25, 25] == True
    assert filled[0, 0] == False

def test_mask_ops_smooth_and_morph_close():
    m = np.zeros((40, 40), dtype=bool)
    m[10:25, 10:18] = True
    m[10:25, 19:27] = True
    closed = mask_ops.morph_close(m, radius_px=1)
    assert closed[15, 18] == True
    assert np.array_equal(mask_ops.morph_close(m, radius_px=0), m)
    assert np.array_equal(mask_ops.smooth(m, sigma=0.0), m)

# 2. Mask Ops (deo 2)
def test_mask_ops_cut_at_line_and_remove_stand():
    m = np.ones((80, 80), dtype=bool)
    cut = mask_ops.cut_at_line(m, y_px=50)
    assert cut[:50, :].all() == True
    assert not cut[50:, :].any()
    assert np.array_equal(mask_ops.remove_stand(m, 50), cut)

def test_mask_ops_polygon_to_mask_and_clean():
    shape = (100, 100)
    pts = [(10, 10), (90, 10), (50, 90)]
    poly_m = mask_ops.polygon_to_mask(pts, shape)
    assert poly_m.dtype == bool and poly_m[30, 50] == True
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        mask_ops.polygon_to_mask([(10, 10), (20, 20)], shape)
    cfg = Config()
    m_noisy = np.zeros(shape, dtype=bool)
    m_noisy[20:80, 20:80] = True
    m_noisy[40:50, 40:50] = False
    cleaned = mask_ops.clean_mask(m_noisy, cfg)
    assert cleaned[45, 45] == True

# 3. Scale
def test_scale_mask_bbox_px():
    m = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=bool)
    m[20:70, 30:80] = True
    assert scale.mask_bbox_px(m) == (30, 20, 80, 70)

def test_scale_compute_scale_dimensions():
    m = np.zeros((120, 100), dtype=bool)
    m[20:70, 30:80] = True   # width 50, height 50
    s_h = scale.compute_scale(m, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0)
    assert s_h.mm_per_px == pytest.approx(2.0)
    assert s_h.height_mm == pytest.approx(100.0)
    s_w = scale.compute_scale(m, reference="width", reference_mm=50.0)
    assert s_w.mm_per_px == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert s_w.width_mm == pytest.approx(50.0)

def test_scale_compute_scale_invalid_args_and_warning():
    empty = np.zeros((40, 40), dtype=bool)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        scale.compute_scale(empty, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0)
    valid = np.zeros((40, 40), dtype=bool)
    valid[10:30, 10:30] = True
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        scale.compute_scale(valid, reference="diagonal", reference_mm=100.0)
    narrow = np.zeros((250, 50), dtype=bool)
    narrow[10:230, 10:18] = True   # height 220, width 8 -> ratio 27.5 > 10.0
    with pytest.warns(scale.SuspiciousAspectRatioWarning):
        scale.compute_scale(narrow, reference="height", reference_mm=110.0)

def test_scale_compute_scale_from_points():
    p1, p2 = (10, 20), (10, 120)   # dist 100 px
    assert scale.compute_scale_from_points(p1, p2, known_mm=50.0) == pytest.approx(0.5)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        scale.compute_scale_from_points(p1, p1, known_mm=50.0)

# 4. Vectorize
def test_vectorize_circle_accuracy():
    """
    Sinteticki krug poznatog poluprecnika R = 40.0 mm.
    Izabrana rezolucija:
      - Maska 2000 x 2000 px, centar (1000, 1000) px, R_px = 800 px.
      - Skala: 2000 px = 100.0 mm -> mm_per_px = 0.05 mm/px.
      - R_mm = 800 * 0.05 = 40.0 mm.
      - Centar konture po konvenciji ivica piksela racuna se iz bbox-a.
    Izracunata tolerancija:
      - Spec 7.6 / Config.curve_sample_tol_mm postavlja toleranciju Beziera na 0.05 mm.
      - Radijalno odstupanje svih temena od 40.0 mm mora biti < 0.05 mm.
    """
    H, W = 2000, 2000
    cy_px, cx_px = 1000, 1000
    r_px = 800
    y, x = np.ogrid[:H, :W]
    m = ((x - cx_px) ** 2 + (y - cy_px) ** 2) <= r_px ** 2

    s = ScaleInfo(mm_per_px=0.05, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0, bbox_px=(0, 0, 2000, 2000))
    poly = vectorize.vectorize_mask(m, s, Config())
    assert poly.is_valid is True

    bbox = scale.mask_bbox_px(m)
    center_x_mm = ((bbox[0] + bbox[2]) / 2.0) * s.mm_per_px
    center_y_mm = ((bbox[1] + bbox[3]) / 2.0) * s.mm_per_px
    coords = np.array(poly.exterior.coords)
    radii = np.hypot(coords[:, 0] - center_x_mm, coords[:, 1] - center_y_mm)
    assert np.max(np.abs(radii - 40.0)) < 0.05

def test_vectorize_empty_mask_raises():
    empty = np.zeros((80, 80), dtype=bool)
    s = ScaleInfo(mm_per_px=0.1, reference="height", reference_mm=10.0, bbox_px=(0, 0, 80, 80))
    with pytest.raises(vectorize.VectorizeError):
        vectorize.vectorize_mask(empty, s, Config())

def test_vectorize_clean_ring_and_contour():
    pts = [(0.0, 0.0), (0.005, 0.0), (10.0, 0.0), (10.0, 10.0), (0.0, 10.0)]
    cleaned = vectorize.clean_ring(pts, min_edge_mm=0.02)
    assert (0.005, 0.0) not in cleaned and len(cleaned) == 4
    with pytest.raises(vectorize.VectorizeError):
        vectorize.contour_to_mm(np.array([[[10, 10]], [[20, 20]]]), mm_per_px=0.1)

# 5. Geometry
def test_geometry_kerf_square_100x100_app_mode():
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    cut = geometry.apply_kerf(nominal, kerf_mm=0.2, kerf_mode="app")
    assert nominal.bounds == (0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    minx, miny, maxx, maxy = cut.bounds
    assert minx == pytest.approx(-0.1, abs=0.01)
    assert miny == pytest.approx(-0.1, abs=0.01)
    assert maxx == pytest.approx(100.1, abs=0.01)
    assert maxy == pytest.approx(100.1, abs=0.01)

def test_geometry_kerf_lightburn_and_zero():
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    assert geometry.apply_kerf(nominal, kerf_mm=0.2, kerf_mode="lightburn").bounds == (0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    assert geometry.apply_kerf(nominal, kerf_mm=0.0, kerf_mode="app").bounds == (0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)

def test_geometry_fill_holes_and_inset():
    poly = Polygon([(0, 0), (100, 0), (100, 100), (0, 100)], holes=[[(30, 30), (70, 30), (70, 70), (30, 70)]])
    filled = geometry.fill_holes(poly)
    assert len(filled.interiors) == 0 and filled.bounds == (0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    inset = geometry.apply_edge_inset(filled, inset_mm=0.5)
    assert inset.bounds == pytest.approx((0.5, 0.5, 99.5, 99.5), abs=0.01)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        geometry.apply_edge_inset(filled, inset_mm=-0.5)

def test_geometry_valid_and_single_polygon():
    bowtie = Polygon([(0, 0), (20, 20), (0, 20), (20, 0), (0, 0)])
    assert geometry.ensure_valid(bowtie).is_valid is True
    with pytest.raises(geometry.GeometryError):
        geometry.ensure_valid(Polygon())
    mp = MultiPolygon([box(0, 0, 50, 50), box(60, 60, 70, 70)])
    single = geometry.ensure_single_polygon(mp)
    assert isinstance(single, Polygon) and single.area == pytest.approx(2500.0)

def test_geometry_simplify_and_clean_edges():
    poly = Polygon([(0, 0), (50, 0), (100, 0), (100, 100), (0, 100)])
    simp = geometry.simplify(poly, tolerance_mm=0.03)
    assert simp.is_valid is True and len(simp.exterior.coords) <= 5
    poly_short = Polygon([(0.0, 0.0), (0.005, 0.0), (50.0, 0.0), (50.0, 50.0), (0.0, 50.0)])
    assert geometry.clean_polygon_edges(poly_short, min_edge_mm=0.02).is_valid is True

def test_geometry_thin_regions_and_compute_cut():
    b1, b2 = box(0.0, 0.0, 20.0, 20.0), box(30.0, 0.0, 50.0, 20.0)
    dumbbell = shapely.ops.unary_union([b1, b2, box(20.0, 9.6, 30.0, 10.4)])
    assert not geometry.find_thin_regions(dumbbell, min_feature_mm=1.5).is_empty
    with pytest.warns(geometry.ThinFeatureWarning):
        geometry.check_min_feature(dumbbell, min_feature_mm=1.5, warn=True)
    mat = MaterialProfile(id="acrylic-3", name="Akril 3mm", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.2)
    geom = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0), mat, kerf_mode="app")
    assert geom.area_mm2 == pytest.approx(10000.0, rel=1e-3)
    assert geom.bbox_nominal_mm == (0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)

def test_svg_polygon_path_data():
    poly = Polygon([(0.0, 0.0), (10.0, 0.0), (5.0, 10.0)])
    d = svg_writer.polygon_path_data(poly, dx=5.0, dy=5.0)
    assert d.startswith("M") and "L" in d and d.endswith("Z")
    for token in d.replace(",", " ").split():
        if token not in ("M", "L", "Z") and "." in token:
            assert len(token.split(".")[1]) <= 3

# 6. SVG Writer (deo 2)
def test_svg_write_cut_svg_xml_structure(tmp_path):
    nominal = box(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0)
    mat = MaterialProfile(id="acrylic-3", name="Akril 3mm", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.2)
    cut_geom = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(nominal, mat, kerf_mode="app")
    svg_path = tmp_path / "lamp_cut.svg"
    svg_writer.write_cut_svg(cut_geom, svg_path, Config(svg_margin_mm=5.0))
    assert svg_path.exists()
    tree = ET.parse(svg_path)
    root = tree.getroot()
    assert root.tag.split("}")[-1] == "svg"
    w_str, h_str = root.get("width"), root.get("height")
    assert w_str.endswith("mm") and h_str.endswith("mm")
    w_val, h_val = float(w_str.replace("mm", "")), float(h_str.replace("mm", ""))
    assert w_val == pytest.approx(110.0, abs=1e-3) and h_val == pytest.approx(110.0, abs=1e-3)
    vb = [float(p) for p in root.get("viewBox").split()]
    assert vb == pytest.approx([0.0, 0.0, 110.0, 110.0], abs=1e-3)
    groups = [el for el in root.iter() if el.tag.split("}")[-1] == "g" and el.get("id") == "cut-outer"]
    assert len(groups) == 1
    g = groups[0]
    assert g.get("stroke") == "#FF0000" and float(g.get("stroke-width")) == pytest.approx(0.1)
    for el in root.iter():
        assert el.tag.split("}")[-1] != "text"
        assert "transform" not in el.attrib

# 7. IO Utils
def test_io_load_image_exif_and_rgb(tmp_path):
    img_path = tmp_path / "exif.jpg"
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1200, 1100), color=(255, 0, 0))
    exif = im.getexif()

# 8. Device
def test_device_pick_device_and_variant():
    assert isinstance(device.torch_available(), bool)
    assert device.pick_device("cpu") == "cpu"
    if not device.torch_available():
        assert device.pick_device("auto") == "cpu"
    assert device.pick_variant("cpu") == "tiny"
    assert device.pick_variant("cuda", vram_gb=4.0) == "small"
    assert device.pick_variant("mps") == "base_plus"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        device.pick_variant("unknown")

def test_device_fallback_variants_chain():
    assert device.fallback_variants("base_plus") == ["base_plus", "small", "tiny"]
    assert device.fallback_variants("small") == ["small", "tiny"]
    assert device.fallback_variants("tiny") == ["tiny"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        device.fallback_variants("unknown")

def test_device_load_with_fallback():
    assert device.is_out_of_memory(MemoryError("OOM")) is True
    assert device.is_out_of_memory(ValueError("err")) is False
    calls, events = [], []
    def loader(v, dev):
        calls.append(v)
        if v == "base_plus":
            raise MemoryError("OOM")
        return f"model_{v}"
    model, v, dev = device.load_with_fallback(
        loader=loader, variants=["base_plus", "small", "tiny"], device="cpu",
        on_fallback=lambda f, n: events.append((f, n))
    )
    assert model == "model_small" and v == "small" and dev == "cpu"
    assert calls == ["base_plus", "small"] and events == [("base_plus", "small")]

# 9. Segmentation
def test_segmentation_mask_from_file(tmp_path):
    mask_arr = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=np.uint8)
    mask_arr[20:80, 20:80] = 255
    p = tmp_path / "mask.png"
    Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(p)
    loaded = segmentation.mask_from_file(p)
    assert loaded.dtype == bool and loaded.shape == (100, 100)
    assert loaded[50, 50] == True and loaded[5, 5] == False
    resized = segmentation.mask_from_file(p, target_size=(50, 50))
    assert resized.shape == (50, 50) and resized.dtype == bool
    with pytest.raises(FileNotFoundError):
        segmentation.mask_from_file(tmp_path / "missing.png")

def test_segmentation_predict_rules_and_offline():
    assert segmentation.Segmenter.predict_multimask_rule(Prompt(points=((10, 10),), labels=(1,))) is True
    assert segmentation.Segmenter.predict_multimask_rule(Prompt(points=((10, 10), (20, 20)), labels=(1, 0))) is False
    assert segmentation.Segmenter.predict_multimask_rule(Prompt(points=((10, 10),), labels=(1,), box=(0, 0, 50, 50))) is False
    with pytest.raises(device.ModelUnavailableError):
        segmentation.Segmenter("tiny", "cpu").predict(Prompt(points=((10, 10),), labels=(1,)))

# 10. Pipeline (End-to-End)
def test_pipeline_end_to_end_synthetic_mask(tmp_path):
    img_path = tmp_path / "synthetic_lamp.png"
    mask_path = tmp_path / "synthetic_mask.png"
    im = Image.new("RGB", (1200, 1200), color=(20, 20, 20))
    im.save(img_path)
    mask_arr = np.zeros((1200, 1200), dtype=np.uint8)
    mask_arr[300:900, 300:900] = 255   # 600 x 600 px kvadrat
    Image.fromarray(mask_arr).save(mask_path)

    cfg = Config(edge_inset_mm={"mockup": 0.0, "photo": 0.0})
    raw_mask = segmentation.mask_from_file(mask_path)
    cleaned_mask = mask_ops.clean_mask(raw_mask, cfg)
    scale_info = scale.compute_scale(cleaned_mask, reference="height", reference_mm=100.0)
    poly = vectorize.vectorize_mask(cleaned_mask, scale_info, cfg)
    nominal = geometry.prepare_nominal(poly, cfg, input_kind="mockup")
    material = MaterialProfile(id="acrylic-3", name="Akril 3mm", thickness_mm=3.0, kerf_mm=0.2)
    cut_geom = geometry.compute_cut_geometry(nominal, material, kerf_mode="app")

    svg_out = tmp_path / "lamp_cut.svg"
    written_svg = svg_writer.write_cut_svg(cut_geom, svg_out, cfg)
    assert written_svg.exists()

    w_mm, h_mm = svg_writer.read_svg_size_mm(written_svg)
    assert w_mm == pytest.approx(110.0, abs=0.5)
    assert h_mm == pytest.approx(110.0, abs=0.5)
    svg_writer.validate_svg(written_svg, w_mm, h_mm, tolerance_mm=1e-3)
